verses.he: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃
verses.en: [A Psalm] of David. Unto Thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

verses.he: אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל־אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל־יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃
verses.en: O my God, in Thee have I trusted, let me not be ashamed; Let not mine enemies triumph over me.

verses.he: גַּ֣ם כָּל־קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.en: Yea, none that wait for Thee shall be ashamed; They shall be ashamed that deal treacherously without cause.

verses.he: דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: Show me Thy ways, O LORD; teach me Thy paths.

verses.he: הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ׀ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.en: Guide me in Thy truth, and teach me; For Thou art the God of my salvation; For Thee do I wait all the day.

verses.he: זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.en: Remember, O LORD, Thy compassions and Thy mercies; For they have been from of old.

verses.he: חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י׀ וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל־תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכָר־לִי־אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions; According to Thy mercy remember Thou me, For Thy goodness' sake, O LORD.

verses.he: טוֹב־וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.en: Good and upright is the LORD; Therefore doth He instruct sinners in the way.

verses.he: יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He guideth The humble in justice; And He teacheth the humble His way.

verses.he: כָּל־אָרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃
verses.en: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth Unto such as keep His covenant and His testimonies.

verses.he: לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲו‍ֹנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־הֽוּא׃
verses.en: For Thy name's sake, O LORD, Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.

verses.he: מִי־זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃
verses.en: What man is he that feareth the LORD? Him will He instruct in the way that He should choose.

verses.he: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: His soul shall abide in prosperity; And his seed shall inherit the land.

verses.he: ס֣וֹד יְ֭הוָה לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם׃
verses.en: The counsel of the LORD is with them that fear Him; And His covenant, to make them know it.

verses.he: עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא־יוֹצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי׃
verses.en: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; For He will bring forth my feet out of the net.

verses.he: פְּנֵה־אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי־יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי׃
verses.en: Turn Thee unto me, and be gracious unto me; For I am solitary and afflicted.

verses.he: צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתַ֗י הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged; O bring Thou me out of my distresses.

verses.he: רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכָל־חַטֹּאותָֽי׃
verses.en: See mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins.

verses.he: רְאֵֽה־אוֹיְבַ֥י כִּי־רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃
verses.en: Consider how many are mine enemies, And the cruel hatred wherewith they hate me. .

verses.he: שָׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל־אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃
verses.en: O keep my soul, and deliver me; Let me not be ashamed, for I have taken refuge in Thee.

verses.he: תֹּם־וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, Because I wait for Thee.

verses.he: פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָֽרוֹתָיו׃
verses.en: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
